stories.title: Drought status declared across Wales as hot weather and lack of rain takes its toll
stories.summary: Drought status has been declared across Wales following a sustained period of high temperatures and a lack of rainfall. Natural Resources Wales (NRW) said today that conditions across Wales’ natural environment had continued to deteriorate, with some groundwater levels lower than expected for this time of year. stories.summary: Wales is one of 55 European football associations that have agreed not to take part in FIFA competitions while plans to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors remain on the table. stories.title: Water supplies hit in Queensferry, Shotton and Sandycroft after burst main
stories.summary: Homes in Queensferry, Shotton and Sandycroft have low pressure or no water after a burst water main, with supplies not expected back to normal until this evening. stories.title: Connah’s Quay darts academy billed as Wales’ biggest aims to find the next Luke Littler
stories.summary: The biggest darts and pool academy in Wales could soon be producing North Wales’ very own Luke Littlers and Gerwyn Prices. After being granted planning permission by Flintshire County Council, work has now begun on Ellis’ Darts – a purpose-built darts and pool academy on Dock Road in Connah’s Quay aimed primarily at young people.

stories.title: 603 people moved to Flintshire from outside the UK, and 754 went the other way, new ONS data shows
stories.summary: More people left Flintshire for countries outside the UK than moved here from them in the twelve months to June 2025, figures published by the Office for National Statistics this morning show.
